mapper.select: select a.attnum, a.empnum, e.empname, -- ✅ 직원명 포함 a.attdate, a.checkin, a.checkout, a.workhours, a.attstate from attendance a join employee e on e.empnum = a.empnum where date(a.attdate) = date(#{date}) order by e.empname asc, ifnull(cast(a.checkin as date), a.attdate) asc, a.attnum asc
select a.attnum, a.empnum, a.attdate, a.checkin, a.checkout, a.workhours, a.attstate, e.empname as empname from attendance a join employee e on e.empnum = a.empnum where a.attnum = #{value}

select a.attnum, a.empnum, a.attdate, a.checkin, a.checkout, a.workhours, a.attstate, e.empname as empname from attendance a join employee e on e.empnum = a.empnum where a.empnum = #{value} order by a.attdate desc, a.attnum desc
mapper.insert: insert into attendance (empnum, attdate, checkin, checkout, workhours, attstate) values ( #{empNum}, /* ✅ 날짜 칼럼은 KST 기준으로 TRUNC */ ifnull( #{attDate,jdbcType=DATE}, curdate() ), /* ✅ 체크인 타임스탬프도 KST 고정 */ ifnull( #{checkIn,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, current_timestamp ), #{checkOut,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, ifnull(#{workHours,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), ifnull(#{attState,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'WORKING') )
mapper.update: update attendance set checkout = ifnull( #{checkOut,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, current_timestamp /* ✅ */ ), workhours = case when checkin is not null then timestampdiff(second, checkin, ifnull(#{checkOut,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, current_timestamp)) else workhours END, attstate = 'DONE' where attnum = #{attNum}

update attendance set empnum = #{empNum}, attdate = #{attDate,jdbcType=DATE}, checkin = #{checkIn,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, checkout = #{checkOut,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, workhours= #{workHours}, attstate = #{attState} where attnum = #{attNum}
mapper.select: select a.attnum, a.empnum, a.attdate, a.checkin, a.checkout, a.workhours, a.attstate, e.empname as empname from attendance a join employee e on e.empnum = a.empnum where a.empnum = #{empNum} and a.attdate between #{from} and #{to} order by a.attdate desc, a.attnum desc

select a.attnum, a.empnum, a.attdate, a.checkin, a.checkout, a.workhours, a.attstate, e.empname as empname from attendance a join employee e on e.empnum = a.empnum where a.attdate between #{from} and #{to} order by e.empname asc, a.attdate desc, a.attnum desc
select a.attnum, a.empnum, e.empname, a.attdate, a.checkin, a.checkout, a.workhours, a.attstate from attendance a join employee e on e.empnum = a.empnum order by a.attdate desc, a.attnum desc
